{'session': 1, 'prompt': "Welcome to the CanvasPulse project. Your first task is to prepare the codebase for a new 'Collections' feature by refactoring the data access layer. Currently, `artwork_repo.c` and `artwork_service.c` are tightly coupled to the 'Artwork' data model. You must abstract the repository pattern to make it generic, so it can be reused for other data models like 'Collections' in the future. After your refactoring, the application must compile successfully, and all existing unit tests in `tests/unit/test_artwork_service.c` must pass, ensuring no regressions in functionality."}
